court: In the High Court of Madras†
appellants: Eswaramoorthy Primary School, Rep. by its Manager .…. Petitioner;
advocates: For Respondents: Mrs. S. Srimathy Special Government Pleader
prayer: Prayer: Petition filed under Section 11 of the Contempt of Courts Act, 1971, to punish the contemnors/respondents herein for their wilful disobedience of the order passed by this Court, dated 27.11.2018, in W.P.(MD) No. 13197 of 2019.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

D. Krishnakumar, J.:— Alleging non-compliance of the order dated 27.11.2018, made in W.P.(MD) No. 13197 of 2019, the present contempt petition has been filed.

2. Today, when the matter is taken up for hearing, it is stated by the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner as well as the learned Special Government Pleader appearing for the respondents that the order dated 27.11.2018, passed in W.P. (MD) No. 13197 of 2018, has been complied with by the first respondent, vide her proceedings dated 08.08.2019.

3. Recording the above said submission, this Contempt Petition is closed.
